newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CBR says Turkish units merger effective.
newsitem.headline: CBR says Turkish units merger effective.

text.p: Belgian cement firm CBR said on Monday the merger of its Turkish Cannakale Cimento unit with Turkish cement group Akcimento would be effective from Tuesday.
CBR and Turkish firm Sabanci will jointly own, on a fifty-fifty basis, a 79.4 percent stake in the merged entity called Akcansa. The remaining 20.6 percent is in public hands.
As announced by the Istanbul Stock Exchange last week, Akcansa will be listed from Tuesday, while Cannakale and Akcimento will be delisted.
CBR is controlled by Germany's Heidelberger Zement.
Akcansa has an annual cement production capacity of 5.4 million tonnes, 30 percent of which is exported, CBR said.
